stem: A hand tool has a loose handle that shifts under load. What is the correct pre-use decision?
choices: Remove it from normal use until its condition is corrected through the authorized process
Use it only on light work and report it at the end of the week
Wrap the handle tightly with tape and mark it for experienced users
Keep it available as a backup because it still performs the task
rationale: Tools must be maintained in safe condition; a defect affecting control is a reason to remove the tool from use rather than improvise a repair.
